pr.title: Shorten the building row to field-audiod, takes a while
pr.head: fc398da3b123b10e883b7e1172eabe176e2239a1

summary: The installer compiles field-audiod, the process that plays audio, when its executable is absent. This change shortens the progress row to building field-audiod, takes a while, so an install or upgrade is easier to scan.

groups.title: Keep the build announcement short
groups.kicker: Installer output and its regression assertion
intro: The announcement uses one short message whether the downloaded audio library is cached or must be fetched. The executable check still suppresses the announcement when the daemon already exists.

files.note: The installer prints the shorter progress message before compiling the audio daemon.

checks.text: Tracing the executable guard and callers confirms the announcement condition and native build command are unchanged.

files.note: The installer test requires the exact short message.
